Have you ever felt that mix of butterflies and uncertainty when stepping into a new relationship? There’s something universal about that longing for a real, lasting connection—one that goes deeper than just fleeting romance.
Together, we’re about to explore a different way of looking at love and partnership—one that’s at the heart of Joshua Harris’s Boy Meets Girl: Say Hello to Courtship. If you’ve ever wondered what it might look like to move beyond the casual dating scene and into something more intentional, you’re in the right place.
Instead of following the usual scripts, this journey invites us to slow down and reflect on what truly matters: our motives, our boundaries, and the role our community plays as we make choices about who we let into our lives. We’ll talk about the joys and challenges of finding a partner with honesty and clarity—building trust through open communication, and holding onto a shared vision for the future.
So, let’s set out together on a path that values authenticity and mutual growth—a path where love isn’t just a spark, but a steady flame that can last. I’m excited for us to reimagine what it means to really meet and know someone. Ready to dive in?
